reactivity.evidence: count 0->3 via 3 signal.set() calls from outside Angular; constructors parent 1->1, child 1->1, sibling 1->1; parent template runs 1->1; unrelated sibling template runs 1->1; info: signal-reading child template runs 1->4 (one view refresh per set). 1 (click) handler: parent 1->2, child 4->5. Granularity is the component view (its template update pass re-runs), not the text node
reactivity.method: signal() read in an OnPush child template (zoneless default); render counters on parent, signal-reading child and unrelated sibling templates + constructors. Pass = no component re-created and non-reading views not refreshed; the reading view re-runs its template per update (view-level, not per-node granularity), recorded as info
